data.name: Basirah
data.gender_notes: Basirah is used as a female name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Basirah is an Arabic name for girls that means 'sighted', 'having good eyesight'. It also means 'insightful', 'having a good understanding of something'. The name Basirah carries the meaning “Sighted, Insightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Basirah usually hope their child will grow to embody sighted, insightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Basirah is associated with the ability to see and understand things on a deeper level, a trait highly valued in Islamic spirituality.
data.etymology: Basirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sighted, Insightful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basirah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: بصيرة
in_arabic.meaning: بصيرة تعني البصيرة و الفهم و الإدراك
in_arabic.long_meaning: بصيرة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و تعني البصيرة و الفهم و الإدراك. و هي من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و هي مشتقة من الفعل 'بصر' الذي يعني 'أن يرى' أو 'أن يبصر'. و بصيرة هي الشخصية التي تتمتع بالفهم و الإدراك و البصيرة النافذة.

in_urdu.name: بصیرہ
in_urdu.meaning: بصیرہ کا مطلب ہے بصیرت، سمجھ، اور ادراک
in_urdu.long_meaning: بصیرہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بصیرت، سمجھ، اور ادراک۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے اور 'بصر' فعل سے مشتق ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'دیکھنا' یا 'بصیرت حاصل کرنا'۔ بصیرہ وہ شخصیت ہے جو سمجھ، ادراک، اور بصیرت کی مالک ہوتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बसीरह
in_hindi.meaning: बसीरह का अर्थ है बुद्धिमत्ता, समझ, और ज्ञान
in_hindi.long_meaning: बसीरह एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमत्ता, समझ, और ज्ञान। यह नाम कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित है और 'बसर' क्रिया से व्युत्पन्न है जिसका अर्थ है 'देखना' या 'बुद्धिमत्ता प्राप्त करना'। बसीरह वह व्यक्ति है जो बुद्धिमत्ता, समझ, और ज्ञान की धनी होती है।

in_pashto.name: بصیره
in_pashto.meaning: بصیره د لید، پوهې، او ادراک معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: بصیره یو ښکلی او معنوي نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د لید، پوهې، او ادراک معنی لري. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم راغلی دی او د 'بصر' کلمې څخه مشتق شوی دی چی د 'لید' یا 'پوهې' معنی لري. بصیره هغه څوک دی چی د پوهې، ادراک، او لید سره ځانګړی وي.

in_english.name: Basirah
in_english.meaning: Insight, understanding, perception, and inner light
in_english.long_meaning: Basirah is a lovely and significant name of Arabic origin. It means insight, understanding, perception, and inner light. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'b-s-r', which means 'to see' or 'to perceive'. In the Quran, basirah refers to the inner light that guides individuals towards knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth. The name Basirah symbolizes a person with a deep understanding, intuition, and inner guidance.

It highlights the importance of wisdom, knowledge, and mental sharpness, which are all highly regarded in the Islamic tradition. Basirah can be seen as a reminder to embrace knowledge and learning, to be discerning and insightful, and to use one's wisdom to make informed decisions in life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Basirah is that it evokes the concept of inner sight or spiritual wisdom. In Islamic spirituality, having good insight and understanding is considered a crucial aspect of a person's relationship with God. It refers to the ability to perceive the divine truth beyond the physical world and to apply this knowledge in one's daily life. The name Basirah can be seen as a reminder to strive for this kind of insight and understanding, and to seek guidance and wisdom from God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Basirah means insight or discernment in Arabic. It represents the ability to perceive and understand truth beyond the surface level. This name is associated with wisdom, intelligence, and the capacity to make sound judgments based on knowledge and experience.
